aggressive_definition_excerpt: Higher serum alpha-tocopherol was associated with reduced risk of prostate cancer (RR, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.66-0.96 for highest versus lowest quintile; Ptrend = 0.03) and was strongly and inversely related to the risk of developing advanced disease (RR, 0.56; 95% CI, 0.36-0.85; Ptrend = 0.002).
study_design: Prospective cohort analysis of the alpha-Tocopherol, beta-Carotene Cancer Prevention Study cohort
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Of the 29,133 Finnish male smokers, ages 50 to 69 years recruited into the study, 1,732 were diagnosed with incident prostate cancer between 1985 and 2004.
reason: The abstract reports both incident prostate cancer overall and risk of developing advanced disease in a cohort followed for up to 19 years.
